label: Hermes Agent
setupHint: Install Hermes with ACP support and configure it with `hermes model`. Store provider API keys in `~/.hermes/.env`; Buzz doesn’t inherit shell exports. Verify with `hermes acp --check`.

label: Claude Code
setupHint: Install and sign in to Claude Code under Settings → Agents → Harnesses. Buzz uses Claude’s own model and credentials; shell credentials are not inherited.
